Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Pets and Animals

宠物与动物

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What's your favourite animal? Why?

My favourite animal has to be cats. I mean, I've never owned one, but their fur looks and feels incredibly soft, and they have this calm, independent character that I find really appealing. I always enjoy watching them in videos.

最喜欢的动物是小猫，因为毛摸起来很软，性格安静独立。

Q2Where do you prefer to keep your pet, indoors or outdoors?

Well, I keep my fish outdoors, actually, in a large tank in the yard. They're basically free-range, swimming around freely, and I only need to feed them, which keeps things simple.

鱼养在户外院子里的大鱼缸里，散养状态，只需喂食。

Q3Have you ever had a pet before?

Yes, I have, and I actually still keep them. We've had fish for quite a few years now, and they're still around. It's not a demanding pet, just some food and clean water, so looking after them has been easy.

养过鱼，现在还养着，不费心，喂食换水就行。

Q4What is the most popular animal in China?

I'd say dogs and cats are the most popular animals in China. You see them everywhere, in parks, on the streets, and all over social media. Lots of young people keep them as companions, especially in big cities.

中国最受欢迎的动物是狗和猫，尤其大城市年轻人爱养。
